description: Record sales a discount code brought in, from the shop's own report: the amount, how many orders, and the day (from) or days (from and to) they cover. Periods for one code can't overlap; remove an entry (code_sale_delete) to correct it. All of a workspace's sales are in one currency. bio_insights_get by post and report_get split each code's sales across posts by their share of its taps, as an estimate.

currency.description: ISO code such as USD; default the workspace's earlier entries, else USD

from.description: The first day it covers (YYYY-MM-DD, the workspace's days)

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

link_id.description: A link with a discount code (links_list)

to.description: The last day it covers; omit for one day

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: code_sale_add
title: Enter sales for a code
